## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `82a6044bab57ff5a84e90afb8b98537df9ad8304`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the one diff path, `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md` (+42/−0: a blockquote under the TL;DR's closing sentence, pre-edit L97, and a blockquote under the §D7 header, pre-edit L461), read against `main` `405a78ea`: the file's heading list (L69–744), each pre-edit line the D7 note names (L97, L178–180, L323–324, L461, L598, L611–615), the record's existing D8 addendum (L520); the anchors the note cites — `packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts#assertDeclaredDependencies` (L996) and `#checkDeclaredDependencies` (L844, "satisfied when `id` is delivered by the same act"), its callers in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts` L335 and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` L2506, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts#installPackage` (L8583) with `registry-artifact-co-ownership.test.ts` L356, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts#isDisableableAppModule` (L756), ADR-0070's 2026-10-31 amendment (L3, L66); the three comments the note cites verbatim or by number — #26986 ruling 6717108024 and measurement 6716259819, #25805 ruling 6500011525, #28117 ruling 6545646924; card #31362, triage 6717444510, claim 6718189666 and os-dev report 6718374467. The hotcrm repository is outside this session's scope: the two hotcrm facts (module manifests at `6961ab1`; hotcrm#2271 closed `not_planned`) are taken from the dev's report and the spec seat's measurement comment, not read here.

Read-only. Card #31362 (ADR-0141's first consumer shelved by #26986 Q0 = A), Tier H, mandatory at-tier review for `docs/adr/**`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No decided text is edited or reversed.** The diff is insert-only (+42/−0); every pre-existing line, including the TL;DR sentence, the §D7 header and body, D4's open-section lead and Open items 1/6/7, is byte-for-byte on `main`. The record's Status line, D1–D6 and D8 are untouched. The two notes are dated, name the ruling of record by issue and comment id, and quote the maintainer verbatim and untranslated, as the record's own D8 addendum and ADR-0070's amendment do.
- **The notes say what the card owes, and no more:** the standalone-revenue consumer is shelved; the shipped shape is one artifact with module disable; D2 and D5 stay declared and built for a future cross-artifact consumer; that consumer reopens #26986 Q1–Q5 (the ruling's own words: "deferred, not rejected") and #25805; D4's open section stays open, "decided with the first consumer — whoever that becomes" (the record's own phrase at L323).
- **The two measured facts hold where I can read them.** (a) D2/D5 on `main`: `assertDeclaredDependencies` is defined at protocol-handshake.ts L996 and called by both install doors; `checkDeclaredDependencies` L844 admits an id "delivered by the same act", which is the "presence only" arm the note names; `installPackage` at registry.ts L8583 is pinned as D5's second co-owner source by the co-ownership test. (b) The disable door reads the module→app tie: `isDisableableAppModule` exists at packages.ts L756, and ADR-0070's 2026-10-31 amendment (L66) states the tie exactly as the note does (`manifest.type: 'module'`, `manifest.dependencies` naming an installed `app`). The hotcrm half of (b) — each module at `6961ab1` declaring `app.objectstack.hotcrm ^6.1.0` — I could not read; it is consistent with the measurement comment, which built against hotcrm `main` `6961ab1`.
- **The rulings are attributed correctly.** 「大包 + 设置里启用模块」 is #25805 ruling D (6500011525, 2026-10-29); "disabled" = hidden, refused on the data plane and by-name reads, data kept, in-process access still served is #28117 ruling A (6545646924, 2026-10-31); Q0 = A and "Q1–Q5 deferred, not rejected" is 6717108024. The anchor `#d7--the-first-consumer-a-hotcrm-module-shipping-on-its-own-revenue-first` is the slug of the unchanged L461 heading; the dev reports `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors` and `check-adr-links` green.

### ② Semver level

- No package is bumped; `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. ADR prose publishes nothing; the right declaration.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Tier H.** This record is the at-tier contract review the claim routed to the director seat; it is not the approval. The PR stays draft until a governed approver (os-zhuang, hotlong) approves; the seat's ACCEPT carries the six-line 速读 and 席位意见, and the `needs-user-decision` label and reviewer request go with it.
- CI on `82a6044b` was in progress when this was written (16 success, 20 skipped, 7 in progress, 0 failure).
- `Fixes #31362` closes the card; the card's two owed items are both met and its "nothing else changes" clause is met by construction.
- Reliance outside scope: the hotcrm manifest fact and hotcrm#2271's `not_planned` state are the dev's and the spec seat's readings; if either is wrong the D7 note's third bullet and its "since closed `not_planned`" aside are the lines to correct. The approver can check hotcrm#2271 in one click.
- The dev's offered status-header pointer line (as the ADR-0146 line the record carries) is the approver's call; the card did not ask for it, and the TL;DR note already sits at the top of the record.

### ④ Design judgment

- Recording a shelved consumer as an addendum that reverses nothing is the right instrument: D2 and D5 are shipped mechanism, independent of who first consumes them, and the record's planning sentences become worked examples without rewriting history. Naming each such sentence in the D7 note is what stops a future reader from re-reading them as a plan.
- Keeping D4's open section open "with the first consumer, whoever that becomes" is correct under A: the questions were never about HotCRM in particular, and closing them now would decide them without a consumer to measure.
- Narrowing face: nothing a consumer could rely on is taken away; the ADR's declared surface (D1–D8) is unchanged.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
